dedupe_keys.name: wind farm control for inertial and primary frequency support

description: Anand, Abhinav and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. Dedicated controllers combine wake steering and curtailment to increase synthetic inertia under converter, drivetrain, aerodynamic and control limits. Representative farm layouts are coupled to a dynamic grid model with differing synchronous-generation shares. The source reports increased inertia under strong wakes and improved simulated disturbance response. This is an evaluated control formulation, not a generic electricity network dataset. The reported upper gain depends on wake conditions and cannot be applied to every farm or grid. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
